name: arbiter
displayName: Arbiter — File Converter · 本地文件转换器
description: MCP tools and slash commands for Arbiter, a local file converter: video, audio, image, document, ebook and archive. The plugin ships no engines — it drives the Arbiter app already installed on your machine, so it stays in step with whatever version you have. Arbiter（调律者转换器）的 MCP 工具与斜杠命令：视频 / 音频 / 图片 / 文档 / 电子书 / 压缩包互转。插件本身不含引擎，它借用本机已安装的 Arbiter 应用。
